author: KEXP
description: Through cosmic jazz-funk, multi-instrumentalist Cochemea creates a culturally rich sonic world of emotional textures and rhythmic possibilities. His in-studio session offers a transcendent performance of "The Land Swallowed Them Whole" and more.
title: Cochemea performs "The Land Swallowed Them Whole" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
